The Lordaeron army was the principal military force of the human kingdom of Lordaeron. Reputed to be deeply religious, the armies of Lordaeron were the first to heed the call to arms issued by Anduin Lothar, and were driven by the belief that humanity must stand steadfast against the blasphemous onslaught of the Orcish Horde. As a major contributor to the Alliance of Lordaeron, the Lordaeron army continued to defend the land from orc and troll incursions after the Second War, until their forces were annihilated by the corrupted Arthas Menethil and his undead servants during the Scourging of Lordaeron.

Love Language Expert is a world event achievement earned by delivering all of the following gifts to Lovely Guests at the Steam Pools Resort in Feralas. This requires the Getaway to Scenic Feralas! daily quest to be available during Love is in the Air in order to progress. Not all gifts can be given the same day that the daily quest is available, as the Mystery Gift will only contain either the flowers or the sealed letter. Deliver three gifts, then return to the event area through the portal, abandon and pick the quest back up. Do not progress after the "Gifts returned (3)" step until all possible gifts have been given.

Love is in the Lair is awarded to players who defeat The Silken Court after Anub'arash and Takazj have gained the Bond of Friendship in Nerub-ar Palace on normal or higher difficulties. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Nerub-ar Raider. Before starting the encounter, one player should pick up the Box of Candy at the base of the steps, and another the Anub'arash Plushy in the doorway to the Kyveza hall. In the boss room, the holding players will get an extra action button which will throw the held items onto the boss. Do not engage in combat between picking up the items and throwing them on the bosses, or the buff will be lost. Reset the encounter to respawn the items in that case.

Loyal Customer is a buff provided by the Gallagio Loyalty Rewards Club while in the Liberation of Undermine raid. It increases damage and healing done, upgrading as the player gains more renown with the club. It is first provided at renown 4, with further upgrades to the buff at renown 7, 10, 13, 16, and 19 by completing their quests: *Loyal Customer: Silver (4), damage and healing at 3% *Loyal Customer: Gold (7), 6% *Loyal Customer: Platinum (10), 9% *Loyal Customer: Black (13), 12% *Loyal Customer: Diamond (16), 15% *Loyal Customer: GOLDEN LEGENDARY!!! (19), 18%

Lua Error is a popup window that appears when an addon or the base game interface encounters a coding error. It helps to identify the addon that failed, where in the code that it failed, and a brief description of the error. This window will popup if scriptErrors is enabled. Alternatively, community-made addons like [https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/bugsack BugSack] (and [https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/bug-grabber BugGrabber]), Swatter, or others can catch and process these errors.
